en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a small Russian Orthodox church with a large onion dome topped by a Russian Orthodox cross. The façade has ornate arches and columns framing the main doorway, above which is an icon painting of religious figures set in a curved niche. The building is enclosed by a low fence along a quiet street with early 20th‑century style lampposts. Hills or wooded slopes are visible in the background.
